summary: Sky Quarry Inc. filed an 8-K reporting an October 1, 2026 Settlement Agreement and Stipulation with LendSpark Corporation, approved by the Circuit Court of the Twelfth Judicial Circuit in DeSoto County, Florida on October 2, 2026, resolving $638,998.00 of past-due Company liabilities via a court-approved Section 3(a)(10) share issuance. Settlement Shares convert at the lower of the prior-day close or five-day average close, issued in up to two tranches, plus 6,000 Settlement Fee Shares, freely tradable without legends. A 4.99% beneficial ownership blocker applies, and LendSpark limits daily resales to 20% of trading volume. Watch dilution and resale overhang.
